import Mathlib

structure TopoGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def TopoGraph.well_formed (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.size (g : TopoGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.has_edge (g : TopoGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def TopoGraph.is_path (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def TopoGraph.is_cycle (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast?

def TopoGraph.graph_has_cycle (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_cycle p

def TopoGraph.is_topological_ordering (g : TopoGraph) (order : Array Nat) : Prop :=
  -- Contains all nodes (size check + surjective)
  order.size = g.size ∧
  (∀ n, n < g.size → ∃ k, k < order.size ∧ order.getD k 0 = n) ∧
  -- No duplicates is implied by size check + surjective on finite set, but for completeness:
  (∀ i j, i < order.size → j < order.size → i ≠ j → order.getD i 0 ≠ order.getD j 0) ∧
  -- No back edges (if j < i, no edge order[i] -> order[j])
  (∀ i j, j < i → i < order.size →
     ¬ g.has_edge (order.getD i 0) (order.getD j 0))

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def topological_sort_precond (graph : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- Successors of `u` as a list, definitionally aligned with `has_edge`. -/
def TopoGraph.succL (g : TopoGraph) (u : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList

/-- `Good g l` : every successor of a node occurs *strictly later* in `l`.
This is exactly the "no back edge" content of a topological ordering. -/
def TopoGraph.Good (g : TopoGraph) : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => True
  | x :: t => (∀ v ∈ g.succL x, v ∈ t) ∧ g.Good t

/-- Sink-peeling step: find a not-yet-emitted node all of whose successors
are already emitted. -/
def TopoGraph.pickNode (g : TopoGraph) (acc : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).find?
    (fun u => !acc.contains u && (g.succL u).all (fun v => acc.contains v))

/-- Kahn's algorithm, sink-peeling form. `acc` holds emitted nodes newest-first. -/
def TopoGraph.peel (g : TopoGraph) : Nat → List Nat → List Nat
  | 0, acc => acc
  | f + 1, acc =>
      match g.pickNode acc with
      | some u => g.peel f (u :: acc)
      | none => acc
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def topological_sort (graph : TopoGraph)
    (h_precond : topological_sort_precond graph) : Option (Array Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  if (graph.peel graph.adj.size []).length = graph.adj.size then
    some (graph.peel graph.adj.size []).toArray
  else
    none
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def topological_sort_postcond (graph : TopoGraph) (result : Option (Array Nat))
    (_ : topological_sort_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some order =>
      ¬ graph.graph_has_cycle ∧
      graph.is_topological_ordering order
  | none =>
      graph.graph_has_cycle
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
namespace TopoAux

/-- `getD` at an in-range index. -/
theorem gdEq (l : List Nat) (k : Nat) (h : k < l.length) : l.getD k 0 = l[k] :=
  List.getD_eq_getElem l 0 h

theorem mem_iff_getD (l : List Nat) (x : Nat) :
    x ∈ l ↔ ∃ k, k < l.length ∧ l.getD k 0 = x := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkx⟩ := List.getElem_of_mem h
    exact ⟨k, hk, by rw [gdEq l k hk]; exact hkx⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    rw [gdEq l k hk]
    exact List.getElem_mem hk

theorem nodup_getD_inj {l : List Nat} (h : l.Nodup) {i j : Nat}
    (hi : i < l.length) (hj : j < l.length) (he : l.getD i 0 = l.getD j 0) : i = j := by
  rw [gdEq l i hi, gdEq l j hj] at he
  exact (List.Nodup.getElem_inj_iff h).mp he

theorem length_le_of_nodup {l : List Nat} {n : Nat} (h : l.Nodup)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ l, x < n) : l.length ≤ n := by
  have h1 : l.toFinset.card = l.length := List.toFinset_card_of_nodup h
  have h2 : l.toFinset ⊆ Finset.range n := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset] at hx
    simp [Finset.mem_range, hb x hx]
  have := Finset.card_le_card h2
  simpa [h1] using this

theorem head?_getD (l : List Nat) (h : 0 < l.length) : l.head? = some (l.getD 0 0) := by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a t => simp [List.getD]

theorem getLast?_getD (l : List Nat) (h : 0 < l.length) :
    l.getLast? = some (l.getD (l.length - 1) 0) := by
  rw [List.getLast?_eq_getElem?, gdEq l _ (by omega)]
  simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (show l.length - 1 < l.length by omega)]

theorem getD_map_range (f : Nat → Nat) (m k : Nat) (h : k < m) :
    ((List.range m).map f).getD k 0 = f k := by
  have hk : k < ((List.range m).map f).length := by simpa using h
  rw [gdEq _ k hk]
  simp

/-- Membership in `succL` versus `has_edge`. -/
theorem hasEdge_iff (g : TopoGraph) (u v : Nat) :
    g.has_edge u v ↔ (u < g.adj.size ∧ v ∈ g.succL u) := by
  simp [TopoGraph.has_edge, TopoGraph.succL]

/-- Specification of a successful `pickNode`. -/
theorem pick_some {g : TopoGraph} {acc : List Nat} {u : Nat}
    (h : g.pickNode acc = some u) :
    u < g.adj.size ∧ u ∉ acc ∧ ∀ v ∈ g.succL u, v ∈ acc := by
  have hmem := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h
  have hp := List.find?_some h
  simp only [List.mem_range] at hmem
  simp at hp
  exact ⟨hmem, hp.1, hp.2⟩

/-- Specification of a failing `pickNode`. -/
theorem pick_none {g : TopoGraph} {acc : List Nat}
    (h : g.pickNode acc = none) :
    ∀ u, u < g.adj.size → u ∉ acc → ∃ v ∈ g.succL u, v ∉ acc := by
  intro u hu hnotin
  simp only [TopoGraph.pickNode, List.find?_eq_none] at h
  have h1 := h u (by simp [List.mem_range, hu])
  simp at h1
  exact h1 hnotin

/-- The key "later occurrence" property carried by `Good`. -/
theorem good_lt (g : TopoGraph) : ∀ (l : List Nat), g.Good l → ∀ i, i < l.length →
    ∀ v ∈ g.succL (l.getD i 0), ∃ j, i < j ∧ j < l.length ∧ l.getD j 0 = v := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ i hi; simp at hi
  | cons x t ih =>
    intro hg i hi v hv
    obtain ⟨hhead, htail⟩ := hg
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      simp only [List.getD_cons_zero] at hv
      have hvt : v ∈ t := hhead v hv
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hkv⟩ := (mem_iff_getD t v).mp hvt
      exact ⟨k + 1, by omega, by simpa using hk, by simpa using hkv⟩
    | succ m =>
      simp only [List.getD_cons_succ] at hv
      have hm : m < t.length := by simpa using hi
      obtain ⟨j, hj1, hj2, hj3⟩ := ih htail m hm v hv
      exact ⟨j + 1, by omega, by simpa using hj2, by simpa using hj3⟩

/-- Loop invariant plus the fuel-accounting disjunction. -/
theorem peel_inv (g : TopoGraph) : ∀ (f : Nat) (acc : List Nat),
    (∀ x ∈ acc, x < g.adj.size) → acc.Nodup → g.Good acc →
    (∀ x ∈ g.peel f acc, x < g.adj.size) ∧ (g.peel f acc).Nodup ∧ g.Good (g.peel f acc) ∧
      ((g.peel f acc).length = acc.length + f ∨ g.pickNode (g.peel f acc) = none) := by
  intro f
  induction f with
  | zero => intro acc h1 h2 h3; exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, Or.inl (by simp [TopoGraph.peel])⟩
  | succ f ih =>
    intro acc h1 h2 h3
    cases hp : g.pickNode acc with
    | none =>
      have : g.peel (f + 1) acc = acc := by simp [TopoGraph.peel, hp]
      rw [this]
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, Or.inr hp⟩
    | some u =>
      have heq : g.peel (f + 1) acc = g.peel f (u :: acc) := by simp [TopoGraph.peel, hp]
      obtain ⟨hu1, hu2, hu3⟩ := pick_some hp
      have k1 : ∀ x ∈ u :: acc, x < g.adj.size := by
        intro x hx; rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
        · exact h ▸ hu1
        · exact h1 x h
      have k2 : (u :: acc).Nodup := List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨hu2, h2⟩
      have k3 : g.Good (u :: acc) := ⟨hu3, h3⟩
      obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3, p4⟩ := ih (u :: acc) k1 k2 k3
      rw [heq]
      refine ⟨p1, p2, p3, ?_⟩
      rcases p4 with hl | hn
      · exact Or.inl (by simp [hl]; omega)
      · exact Or.inr hn

/-- A `Good`, duplicate-free, complete list rules out every cycle. -/
theorem no_cycle_of_good (g : TopoGraph) (hw : g.well_formed) (L : List Nat)
    (hnd : L.Nodup) (hgood : g.Good L)
    (hsurj : ∀ m, m < g.adj.size → m ∈ L) : ¬ g.graph_has_cycle := by
  have hex : ∀ x, ∃ k, x < g.adj.size → (k < L.length ∧ L.getD k 0 = x) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x < g.adj.size
    · obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := (mem_iff_getD L x).mp (hsurj x hx)
      exact ⟨k, fun _ => ⟨hk1, hk2⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨0, fun h => absurd h hx⟩
  choose pos hpos using hex
  -- an edge strictly increases `pos`
  have hstep : ∀ u v, g.has_edge u v → pos u < pos v := by
    intro u v he
    rw [hasEdge_iff] at he
    obtain ⟨hu, hv⟩ := he
    have hvlt : v < g.adj.size := hw u hu v (by simpa [TopoGraph.succL] using hv)
    obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hpos u hu
    obtain ⟨hq1, hq2⟩ := hpos v hvlt
    have hv' : v ∈ g.succL (L.getD (pos u) 0) := by rw [hp2]; exact hv
    obtain ⟨j, hj1, hj2, hj3⟩ := good_lt g L hgood (pos u) hp1 v hv'
    have : pos v = j := nodup_getD_inj hnd hq1 hj2 (by rw [hq2, hj3])
    omega
  rintro ⟨p, ⟨hlen0, hedge⟩, hlen1, hhl⟩
  -- pos increases by at least 1 per step along the path
  have hmono : ∀ k, k < p.length → pos (p.getD 0 0) + k ≤ pos (p.getD k 0) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro _; omega
    | succ m ihm =>
      intro hm
      have hm' : m < p.length := by omega
      have h1 := ihm hm'
      have h2 := hstep _ _ (hedge m hm)
      omega
  have hlast : p.getD 0 0 = p.getD (p.length - 1) 0 := by
    have e1 := head?_getD p hlen0
    have e2 := getLast?_getD p hlen0
    rw [e1, e2] at hhl
    exact Option.some.inj hhl
  have := hmono (p.length - 1) (by omega)
  rw [← hlast] at this
  omega

end TopoAux
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem topological_sort_postcond_satisfied (graph : TopoGraph)
    (h_precond : topological_sort_precond graph) :
    topological_sort_postcond graph (topological_sort graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  open TopoAux in
  have hw : graph.well_formed := h_precond
  set n := graph.adj.size with hn
  set L := graph.peel n ([] : List Nat) with hLdef
  obtain ⟨hb, hnd, hgood, hdisj⟩ :=
    peel_inv graph n [] (by simp) (by simp) (by simp [TopoGraph.Good])
  have hle : L.length ≤ n := length_le_of_nodup hnd hb
  have hdef : topological_sort graph h_precond =
      if L.length = n then some L.toArray else none := rfl
  rw [hdef]
  by_cases hlen : L.length = n
  · rw [if_pos hlen]
    -- surjectivity: L is nodup, bounded by n, and of length n
    have hsurj : ∀ m, m < n → m ∈ L := by
      have hcard : L.toFinset = Finset.range n := by
        apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
        · intro x hx
          simp only [List.mem_toFinset] at hx
          exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (hb x hx)
        · rw [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnd, hlen]
          simp
      intro m hm
      have : m ∈ L.toFinset := by rw [hcard]; simp [Finset.mem_range, hm]
      simpa using this
    have hsize : L.toArray.size = graph.size := by
      have h1 : L.toArray.size = L.length := by simp
      rw [h1, hlen]; exact hn
    have hgetD : ∀ k, L.toArray.getD k 0 = L.getD k 0 := by
      intro k
      simp [Array.getD, List.getD]
      split <;> rename_i h
      · rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem h]; simp
      · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)]; simp
    have hlenA : L.toArray.size = L.length := by simp
    refine ⟨no_cycle_of_good graph hw L hnd hgood hsurj, hsize, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro m hm
      have hm' : m < n := by simpa [TopoGraph.size] using hm
      obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2⟩ := (mem_iff_getD L m).mp (hsurj m hm')
      exact ⟨k, by rw [hlenA]; exact hk1, by rw [hgetD]; exact hk2⟩
    · intro i j hi hj hij hcon
      rw [hlenA] at hi hj
      rw [hgetD, hgetD] at hcon
      exact hij (nodup_getD_inj hnd hi hj hcon)
    · intro i j hji hi hcon
      rw [hlenA] at hi
      rw [hgetD, hgetD] at hcon
      rw [hasEdge_iff] at hcon
      obtain ⟨_, hmem⟩ := hcon
      obtain ⟨k, hk1, hk2, hk3⟩ := good_lt graph L hgood i hi _ hmem
      have hjl : j < L.length := by omega
      have : k = j := nodup_getD_inj hnd hk2 hjl hk3
      omega
  · rw [if_neg hlen]
    have hstuck : graph.pickNode L = none := by
      rcases hdisj with h | h
      · exact absurd (by simpa using h) hlen
      · exact h
    have hlt : L.length < n := by omega
    -- there is an unemitted node
    have hu0 : ∃ u, u < n ∧ u ∉ L := by
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have hsub : Finset.range n ⊆ L.toFinset := by
        intro x hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hx
        simpa using hcon x hx
      have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
      have h2 : L.toFinset.card ≤ L.length := List.toFinset_card_le L
      simp only [Finset.card_range] at this
      omega
    obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀1, hu₀2⟩ := hu0
    -- every stuck node has a stuck successor
    have hstep : ∀ u, (u < n ∧ u ∉ L) → ∃ v, (v < n ∧ v ∉ L) ∧ v ∈ graph.succL u := by
      intro u hu
      obtain ⟨v, hv1, hv2⟩ := pick_none hstuck u hu.1 hu.2
      have : v < n := hw u hu.1 v (by simpa [TopoGraph.succL] using hv1)
      exact ⟨v, ⟨this, hv2⟩, hv1⟩
    choose! nxt hnxt1 hnxt2 using hstep
    have hiter : ∀ k, (nxt^[k] u₀ < n ∧ nxt^[k] u₀ ∉ L) := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => exact ⟨hu₀1, hu₀2⟩
      | succ m ihm =>
        rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
        exact hnxt1 _ ihm
    -- pigeonhole: two of the first n+1 iterates coincide
    have hpigeon : ∃ a ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∃ b ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        a ≠ b ∧ nxt^[a] u₀ = nxt^[b] u₀ := by
      apply Finset.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to (t := Finset.range n)
      · simp
      · intro a _
        exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (hiter a).1
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb', hab, heq⟩ := hpigeon
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at ha hb'
    -- normalise so that i < j
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq'⟩ : ∃ i j, i < j ∧ nxt^[i] u₀ = nxt^[j] u₀ := by
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with h | h
      · exact ⟨a, b, h, heq⟩
      · exact ⟨b, a, h, heq.symm⟩
    refine ⟨(List.range (j - i + 1)).map (fun k => nxt^[i + k] u₀), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp
    · intro m hm
      simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range] at hm
      rw [getD_map_range _ _ _ (by omega), getD_map_range _ _ _ (by omega)]
      rw [hasEdge_iff]
      refine ⟨(hiter (i + m)).1, ?_⟩
      have : i + (m + 1) = (i + m) + 1 := by omega
      rw [this, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      exact hnxt2 _ (hiter (i + m))
    · simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range]; omega
    · rw [head?_getD _ (by simp), getLast?_getD _ (by simp)]
      simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range]
      rw [getD_map_range _ _ _ (by omega), getD_map_range _ _ _ (by omega)]
      have h1 : i + 0 = i := by omega
      have h2 : i + (j - i + 1 - 1) = j := by omega
      rw [h1, h2, heq']
  -- !benchmark @end proof
